ratingVocabulary.scopeStatus: NSQHS source-bound external vocabulary validated locally; later scheme coverage and native persistence remain open

evidenceVersionRule: authoritative-system/key/exact-version; observation-period and native-history-version remain separate
legacyMappingAliasRule: retain MappingKey and DocumentUID/DocumentVersion; explicit EvidenceVersionKey compatibility binding only, no inferred edition equality

identityBindings.FrameworkKey: Existing edition-specific key in PPG Framework Editions; do not rekey. Join to an external Edition only where its frameworkKeys array contains this exact key.
identityBindings.RequirementKey: Existing key in PPG Standard Requirements; preserve keys, hierarchy and existing rows; publisher codes are separate attributes.
identityBindings.PublicationKey: External catalogue publication identity; do not mint one from a URL or citation occurrence.
identityBindings.EditionKey: External catalogue publisher-edition identity; distinct from the local FrameworkKey and linked only by explicit frameworkKeys membership.
identityBindings.CaptureKey: External catalogue captured-representation identity; bind to the exact EditionKey and verified source-byte SHA-256. SharePoint file history/ETag and capture observation times remain distinct.
identityBindings.DocumentUID: Existing local policy identity; reference occurrences bind it with source version, hashes and exact offsets.
identityBindings.Reference/Resolution: External catalogue occurrence and candidate-resolution records. They are not PPG dependency records, framework requirements or compliance mappings.

minimalCompatibleContract.frameworkJoin: External Edition.frameworkKeys contains the exact existing FrameworkKey; no EditionKey column is added to PPG Framework Editions for this bridge.
minimalCompatibleContract.representationJoin: One observed retained representation is recorded as a Capture with MIME type, URL, byte hash and acquisition/observation data; no separate RepresentationKey is required for the bounded NSQHS bridge.
minimalCompatibleContract.ambiguityAndAliasRule: Keep Unknown/Conflicting and multiple candidates explicit. Alias resolution is evidence-bound and reversible; do not rekey or merge existing publication/edition records from title or URL alone. Native promotion remains unqualified.
minimalCompatibleContract.correctionBoundary: Catalogue owner prepares source assertions; assigned native writer applies conditional changes and reads back. Conflicts retain human edits and stop promotion.
minimalCompatibleContract.captureBoundary: Sourcing owner owns acquisition receipts and bytes; catalogue owner owns publication/edition identity, selection and coverage. No access or rights change is implied.
minimalCompatibleContract.completionBoundary: Identity joins do not establish source completeness, normative requirement completeness, applicability, evidence sufficiency, acceptance or accreditation readiness.

nativeRequirementPersistenceEvidence.scope: 533 selected May 2021 NSQHS nodes; retained proof, not a new register read

sourceSurveillanceBinding: A source-surveillance sourceKey is producer-local identity, not PublicationKey, EditionKey or CaptureKey. Join an observed source only on explicit publisher/edition evidence and exact byte hash; preserve sourceKey, native version reference and observation timestamp separately.

supersedes.policy: Preserve v1 and its existing FS/EC pins; v2 adoption does not repin or approve producer contracts.

historicalNativeExtensionGaps: RequirementCode is required; unnumbered source segments need a compatible separate local key without fabricated publisher code
No inspected native fields store scoped evidence-version/context/assessment entities
Source-bound full text and immutable capture references need an additive field binding; preserve existing summaries
nativeExtensionGaps: FS/EC owner-confirmed cohort and destination-field boundary remain unresolved
Native scheme vocabulary/authority persistence and later scheme coverage remain unqualified

sourceBindingValidation.mode: optional supplied EC catalogue export; exact keys/kinds/endpoints/framework membership/hash
